# Feature: Meshy avatar generating overlay

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
While Meshy generates a character, the Character Editor portrait preview shows a ChatGPT-like loading animation (shimmer + progress) instead of only the static “CH” initials fallback. Generation status stays owned by AvatarMeshyPanel; the preview is a consumer overlay only.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor open; Avatar-Quelle = “Mit KI erstellen”.
- Meshy BYOK configured (or mock); user can start a job.
- No modelUrl yet (or prior model may remain under overlay).

## Happy Path
- [ ] After cost confirm & start, preview shows generating overlay (`data-avatar-meshy-generating="true"`) with label and progress %.
- [ ] Overlay updates as job progress polls (queued → generating → rigging).
- [ ] On success, overlay clears and model appears via existing `onSuccess` modelUrl path.
- [ ] Panel status text still works; no second Meshy API call for the overlay.

## Edge Cases
- [ ] On failed / provider-unavailable / idle: overlay hidden.
- [ ] Switching away from meshy source: overlay not shown (panel unmounted; state cleared or ignored).
- [ ] Reload with sessionStorage job id: overlay resumes if poll returns busy status.
- [ ] AvatarSurfaceViewer used outside editor (Session/Token) unchanged — no Meshy coupling.

## Regression
- [ ] Import / SagaDrive avatar sources still show viewer without overlay.
- [ ] Existing Meshy start/poll/retry flow unchanged.

## Assumptions
- Overlay lives in CharacterEditor only; Viewer stays Meshy-agnostic.
- Busy statuses: `queued` | `generating` | `rigging` (analyzing may briefly show after materialization — optional; show overlay through `rigging` only so model can appear during analyzing).

## Security Coverage
- F-a11y: `role="status"`, `aria-busy`, live progress text — no secrets in UI.
- No new endpoints / keys / storage paths.
- Out of scope: Backend B-xx (UI-only consumer of existing job snapshot).

## Composition Gate
- Producer: AvatarMeshyPanel job snapshot (one source of truth).
- Consumer: CharacterEditor overlay (1:1 display; no fan-out side effects).
- Invalid/missing job → no overlay (fail closed).
